name: Black Pelican Tattoo
phone_source: Confirmed independently across Birdeye, Yahoo Local, Giftly, BestProsInTown, InkRoster and the Instagram bio (WALK INS WELCOME text).
rating_source: reviews.birdeye.com/black-pelican-tattoo-149489581572024 (aggregated review score, 4.8 stars / 115 reviews, matches the number supplied in the assignment). Yelp shows a separate, lower tally (30 reviews, ~4.4-4.5 stars) since it counts Yelp-only reviews; Birdeye is used as the primary figure per PIPELINE (broadest aggregate close to Google).
owners_note: Formerly of Big Kahuna Tattoo, per Birdeye and Ink Roster business descriptions.
pricing_note: No price list found on any public source (no Booksy/Square/Fresha booking platform in use). Site uses the adapted 'quoted in person' pattern instead of inventing prices.
hours_source: Cross-referenced across two independent aggregator crawls (Birdeye summary and a Google-search AI overview) that agree: Mon-Thu 2pm-10pm, Fri-Sat 2pm-11pm, Sun 1pm-6pm. Note: one AI search-overview snippet attributed to the Instagram bio gave a conflicting 'Mon-Sat 1pm-9pm, Sun 1pm-6pm', but a direct WebFetch of the live Instagram bio text could not be completed (429 rate limit each attempt); went with the version confirmed twice independently.
ig_bio_text: WALK INS WELCOME, Boca Raton FL (561)419-7847 (hours line present, exact wording pulled from a search snippet, not a direct fetch of the live bio)
facebook_note: Facebook page exists but WebFetch could not read the About section (Facebook served its own login wall instead of page content).
website_candidates_rotos: https://blackpelicantattoo.com (HTTP 503, and Birdeye lists the site URL itself as http://blackpelicantattoo.com/cgi-sys/suspendedpage.cgi, the generic cPanel 'hosting account suspended' page)
website_note: The domain blackpelicantattoo.com is registered but does not serve a real site: it resolves to a hosting-suspended placeholder page (confirmed via WebFetch, HTTP 503, and independently via Birdeye's own stored website field which points straight at the suspended-page URL). Treated as has_own_site: false since there is no usable content to redesign, but this is worth mentioning in outreach as a bonus hook (their old site lapsed).
email_search_log: Instagram bio (search-snippet + WebFetch attempts, all 429 rate-limited): no email or link in bio, only phone/address/hours text
Facebook About section: blocked by Facebook login wall via WebFetch
Booking platform: none exists (no Booksy/Square/Fresha/GlossGenius profile found for this business)
Domain blackpelicantattoo.com: suspended hosting page, no content, no mailto
Birdeye business listing: no email field populated
Yelp business page: blocked (403) via WebFetch; no email visible in earlier indexed snippets
Giftly gift-card page: address/phone only, explicitly 'no email listed'
Yahoo Local listing: no email field
General web search for '"Black Pelican Tattoo" email contact': no direct email surfaced, only a generic note that the email domain would presumably be blackpelicantattoo.com

reviews.author: Jake Mattinson
reviews.quote: Hands down one of the best tattoo shops I've ever been to, and I've been to a lot. I came in with an old tattoo that honestly wasn't very good and needed to be finished and fixed. Shane absolutely crushed it and brought it back to life.

reviews.author: Cliff Milbrun
reviews.quote: I'm so happy with my tattoo and piercings! Nicole, you truly did an amazing job, everything came out perfect, and I'm completely obsessed. You made the whole experience comfortable and fun.

reviews.author: Carly Mittleman
reviews.quote: This shop is AMAZING, AMAZING! Everyone here does amazing tattoos! I go to Jason Holley and he is awesome! Every time I am astonished by his quality of work.

reviews.author: Terry Stein
reviews.quote: Shane is the best! He is very talented and artistic, does great work. Just finished up a beautiful cover up for me.
reviews.note: Additional quote found during research, not used on the site (3 testimonials fit the template layout).

reviews.author: Michelle ZurSchmiede
reviews.quote: He not only gave me the tattoo I have been dreaming of for ten years he was also able to give me excellent placement, size, and design options.
reviews.note: Additional quote found during research, not used on the site.

brand_vibe: Traditional American / Japanese tattoo studio, bold color linework on skin, moody shop interior lined with framed flash art. Built on dark-v2 with a hue shift to steel/navy blue (distinct from artwolf-tattoo-bocaraton's gold, the other Boca Raton tattoo demo already in the registry) to evoke the pelican/coastal name without repeating a palette already used for the same city+niche.
photos_source: scripts/ig_photos.py against @blackpelicantattoo via the Railway IG photo service, 12 photos returned, all verified as real (non-empty, valid JPEG) with `file`. Visually curated: 6 used in the gallery (finished tattoos on skin + one flash sheet), 2 used in the About section (shop interior action shot, second flash sheet), 1 reused as the small logo/avatar (no dedicated logo image exists for this business). 3 source photos discarded from any use: an event flyer ('Bike Night' poster with heavy text overlay), a bike-night action photo with a small text watermark, and a student-discount marketing flyer with heavy text overlay.
